project_type: Python 3.12 monorepo (single uv project 'ossbot') + bash provisioning/entrypoints + PowerShell 5.1 host scripts + systemd units + Dockerfiles, running inside the dedicated, PROVISIONED WSL2 distro 'ossbot' on Windows 11 Home build 26100. Components: gatekeeper (FastAPI over UDS /run/ossbot/gatekeeper.sock, SQLite, python-telegram-bot long polling), sandboxd, dockerfilter (root), watchdog (root timer), ossctl (typer), sandbox_tools (stdlib, baked into images). Phase 2 adds: runner (src/ossbot/runner, empty package today), Hermes v0.22.2 as user hermes, vendored hermes-kiro-provider fork (vendor/hermes-kiro-provider), chat relay, Windows shutdown hooks, backup/restore, docs.
language: Python 3.12 (primary); bash 5; PowerShell 5.1 (CRLF, no pwsh-only syntax); Dockerfile; SQL (SQLite)
build_system: uv 0.13.1 at /opt/ossbot/bin/uv inside the distro; pyproject.toml + uv.lock, every install '--frozen' (run 'uv lock' only when changing dependencies, pin with ==). Dev venvs on ext4: /home/ossadmin/.venvs/ossbot (DEV) and /root/.venvs/ossbot (ROOTDEV); sync them with DEV/ROOTDEV 'uv sync --frozen' after a lock change. Deployment: 'powershell -NoProfile -File d:\Work\autonomous-oss-contributor\scripts\bootstrap.ps1' (phases wsl, hyperv, provision, autostart; '-Only provision' redeploys app + units; '-Steps <a,b>' passes provision.sh --only). provision.sh 'app deploy' rsyncs src/ pyproject.toml uv.lock prompts/ vendor/ to /opt/ossbot/app and runs 'uv sync --frozen --no-dev'; the services run the deployed copy, so redeploy before any live or system test of changed code. The 'images' step rebuilds sandbox images when their inputs change (sandbox-full ~10 min) and rewrites config/versions.lock.yaml digests (commit that file). Windows git has core.autocrlf=true; .gitattributes keeps LF everywhere except *.ps1 (CRLF).
test_framework: pytest 9 + pytest-asyncio + respx + hypothesis, --strict-markers. Markers: unit, telegram, acp, e2e (FakeRuntime + local fakes), e2e_docker (root, real Docker), sandbox (root, Docker + images), system, isolation. Root shell system tests: tests/system/*.sh (helpers in tests/system/lib.sh, PHASE1_UNITS list, SKIPs counted separately). Windows tests: tests\system\test_kill.ps1, scripts\test-isolation.ps1. Existing fakes: tests/fakes/{fake_github.py,fake_telegram.py}; sandbox harness tests/sandboxharness.py and tests/sandbox/conftest.py (drives JobService.execute directly, reusable for e2e_docker); git harness tests/githarness.py. tests/unit/test_systemd_units.py asserts hardening lines (RestrictAddressFamilies, io_uring SystemCallFilter, SystemCallArchitectures=native, TimeoutStopSec) for every ossbot-*.service with a non-root User=, so new units must carry them.
build_command: powershell -NoProfile -File d:\Work\autonomous-oss-contributor\scripts\bootstrap.ps1 -Only provision   (redeploy app, units, images as needed; a second run must print only 'unchanged')

Baseline at e0ecf11: DEV pytest -m "unit or telegram or acp or e2e" = 1557 passed, 11 deselected. The matrix check command (robust to escaped pipes) is in that file. 1) Read d:\Work\autonomous-oss-contributor\docs\PLAN.md (decisions + your FEAT's items), then your FEAT file, then the docs/TRACEABILITY.md rows your items name, then only the DESIGN.md sections and ADRs they cite (DESIGN.md revision 5 is the single spec; the CR files under docs/plan/ are historical). When an item closes rows, set them to done with evidence in the same commit. 2) Before writing code that depends on a DESIGN §23 [VERIFY] item, check it by web search or live probe and record the result in config/versions.lock.yaml or an 'Implementation addendum' at the end of the named ADR. 3) Run every verification command of the FEAT from Windows PowerShell with the DEV/ROOTDEV/ROOT prefixes. wsl.exe --exec passes PowerShell-quoted args intact; never use 'wsl -- bash -c "..."' with embedded quotes; multi-line root scripts go over stdin with CR stripped: (Get-Content -Raw <file>) -replace "`r","" | wsl.exe -d ossbot -u root -- bash -s -- <args>, or the Invoke-OssWsl / Invoke-OssStream helpers in scripts\lib\common.ps1 (they avoid the UTF-8 BOM that Process.StandardInput adds under code page 65001 and base64 args containing double quotes). 4) Lint gate on every Python change; shellcheck on every changed shell file. 5) Redeploy (bootstrap -Only provision) before running system tests, live checks or doctor against changed code. 6) Live checks (secrets exist, see docs/plan/NOTE-live-secrets.md) go through product code only (ossctl doctor --probes, ossctl subcommands, gatekeeper endpoints); record each result (date, command, outcome, no secret values) in docs/VERIFICATION.md under '## Phase 2 live checks'. A failure caused by the user's token/key goes under 'User action needed' in docs/FINAL_REPORT.md; do not work around it. 7) Record what later FEATs need in your FEAT's 'findings'.

environment_constraints: Distro 'ossbot' is provisioned and running; Phase 1 is APPROVED at commit 1db5c14 (review round 6, docs/review-phase1.json). Always pass -u root or -u ossadmin (plain wsl.exe -d ossbot lands as ossnobody); /mnt/c is gone; Linux cannot run Windows exes. Set $env:WSL_UTF8=1 in every PowerShell session. Host files allowed outside the repo: %USERPROFILE%\.wslconfig (only via bootstrap), Scheduled Tasks named ossbot-* (autostart, shutdown hook), optional Hyper-V firewall rules, and Start-menu shortcuts only with bootstrap -Shortcuts. The CR-003 design workflow has finished (merged into DESIGN.md §14 on 2026-10-18); 'git status --porcelain' must be empty after each commit. Long operations (image builds, bootstrap, e2e_docker) need long timeouts (up to 1800 s) or background runs.
contribution_requirements: Binding rules: DESIGN invariants I1-I13 (§8.3) are non-negotiable; DESIGN.md revision 5 is the single spec (CR-001..CR-004 are merged and historical); a decision change updates DESIGN.md, the ADR and docs/TRACEABILITY.md in the same FEAT; only gatekeeper/submit.py imports gatekeeper/github_writer.py (import-linter, 4 contracts today; add a contract for every new privileged writer); runner, sandboxd, sandbox_tools and the Hermes plugin never import gatekeeper; argv lists only, never shell=True; pydantic extra=forbid on every external model (extra=ignore only where DESIGN says so, e.g. Hermes /v1/toolsets N7); LLM and Hermes output is untrusted data, parsed through schemas, rendered escaped, never executed as a command; no personal values or secrets in tracked files outside docs/ (owner values only in gitignored config/profile.yaml; tests use tests/fixtures/profile.test.yaml); never overwrite pre-existing .kiro/ files; Conventional Commits; an ADR 'Implementation addendum' for every verified fact or decision change; every new non-root unit copies the gatekeeper/sandboxd unit pattern (Requires both firewall units, ExecStartPre=+/opt/ossbot/bin/ossbot-firewall --check, ConditionPathExists=!/var/lib/ossbot/control/killed, RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6, SystemCallFilter=~io_uring_setup io_uring_enter io_uring_register, SystemCallErrorNumber=EPERM, SystemCallArchitectures=native, ProtectHome=yes|tmpfs, TimeoutStopSec>=150) and is added to OSSBOT_ENABLE_UNITS in scripts/lib/services.sh, the ossbot-kill stop list and tests/system/lib.sh.
key_patterns: Deterministic safety code with exhaustive parametrized tests. Approvals: binding = sha256(canonical_json) recomputed at Approve/Confirm/before first write; message-bound single-use ui_tokens (callback_data 't:'+22 chars, purposes listed in migrations/0001_init.sql ui_tokens comment); control_checkpoint() before every GitHub write. Telegram: handlers.py dispatches by token purpose; commands register via @command(name, help, safety='read|stop|go|config') in telegram/commands/*.py, go/config reply with Confirm(purpose) handled by @confirm_handler; plugins via entry-point group ossbot.telegram_commands; registry.menu() feeds setMyCommands. Root actions requested by the gatekeeper use flag files in /var/lib/ossbot/control (gatekeeper:osscontrol 2750) watched by root .path units (pattern: systemd/ossbot-resume.path -> ossbot-enforce-resume.service -> scripts/bin/ossbot-resume --request, self-contained bash). Lifecycle (CR-001, DESIGN §13.5): /var/lib/ossbot/control/lifecycle JSON, ControlService.drain/up exist, common.control_flags.require_up, ossctl up/down/status, scripts/{up,down,status}.ps1. Fail closed everywhere (unparseable flag = most restrictive). Model switch: gatekeeper/models_admin.py (ruamel round-trip, atomic replace keeping mode/group) + api/models.py (GET /v1/models, PUT /v1/models/{role}, GET/POST /v1/models/catalog) already exist. Doctor checks return Result(PASS|WARN|FAIL|SKIP|AWAITING SECRET); Hermes checks are SKIP placeholders until FEAT-007. Idempotent provision steps print changed/unchanged. Egress is data: config/egress.yaml categories, sandbox_profiles, host_callers and always_denied go through the config snapshot to ossbot.ctl.render squid with no per-profile special cases.
